patch_description: Split RZ gates into pre-entanglement (rz_pre) and post-entanglement (rz_post) phases while switching back to RY gates (which showed better convergence in prior programs). This reduces parameter count from 14 to just 3 (ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post), dramatically improving parameter efficiency while maintaining the proven RY→RZ→CZ→RZ structure. The separate phase controls allow fine-tuning of quantum interference timing around the CZ chain without increasing circuit depth significantly.
